body: This 2025 Sprinter AWD 170 build in our El Capitan Tier is built for long road trips, camping, and comfortable travel. With 800Ah lithium power, solar, roof A/C, diesel heat, a 33 gallon water system, indoor shower, full kitchen, Starlink, upgraded suspension, and exterior storage, it’s designed to handle longer stays on the road with plenty of comfort and capability.
